<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="上下文管理与压缩" id="ctx"> <mxGraphModel dx="-604" dy="-222" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1150" pageHeight="800" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="log" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="会话事件日志（append-only，JSONL）
seq 从 0 单调递增
assistant/chunk、tool/result、turn/start…
一个事件都不可变、不删改" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="330" x="60" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="surface" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="surface 投影（session.surface.nodes）
surfaceOp {op:'replace', start, end}
→ folded.replacements[] + shadowedSeqs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="330" x="500" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="messages" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="deriveMessages()
模型实际看到的消息列表
= 日志按投影折叠后的结果" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="200" x="900" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="trigger" parent="1" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="压缩触发（compaction-basic）
压力触发：used / contextWindow ≥ 0.8
溢出触发：provider 报 CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="290" x="90" y="240" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="summarize" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="摘要请求：原文前缀 + COMPACTION_INSTRUCTION
作为最后一条 user 消息（KV 前缀命中）
保留尾部 retainRatio=0.16 原文，工具调用配对平衡" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="370" x="460" y="240" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="commit" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="提交顺序：compaction/summary
→ user/message 带 surfaceOp replace
→ compaction/end（start 事件是持久锁）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="370" x="460" y="400" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="prune" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="工具结果裁剪（tool-result-pruner）
确定性码点级 head/tail 截断 + PRUNE_MARKER
紧贴 replacement 记 shadow 价格" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="340" x="60" y="420" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="spill" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="外溢（spill）：超限文本结果落磁盘
上下文只留 head/tail 预览 + 通知
read 工具豁免（防读→溢→读死循环）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="340" x="60" y="570" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="runtime" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="运行时上下文（runtime context）
持久 user 消息：最新快照覆盖旧快照
skills 目录、todo、goal 都走这条路" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="370" x="500" y="570" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="log" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;" target="surface" value="投影替换"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="surface" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;" target="messages" value="折叠导出"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="trigger" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="summarize"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="summarize" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="commit"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="commit" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;dashed=1;" target="surface" value="写回投影"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="prune" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="trigger"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e7" edge="1" parent="1" source="spill" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="prune"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e8" edge="1" parent="1" source="runtime" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="surface"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
